title: Constructed varying-ring realization and simultaneous operations
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. There exists a family c of commutative ring sheaves on the vertical pro-etale sites satisfying TowerCoefficients of [def-sp-compact-projection-presentation], including its module-presheaf-preserving equivalence with the actual coefficient towers. Moreover c admits a simultaneous presentation with invertible open comparison mates.

proof.text: Identify the generated vertical topology with verticalDiagramSiteTopology by checking both inclusions of covering sieves. Uncurry the actual commutative quotient-ring sheaves. Each vertical restriction is the corresponding constant ring sheaf, so the vertical sheaf criterion proves the sheaf condition. Use the proved spatial coefficient maps and their naturality to construct the structural ring maps.

proof.text: The vertical sheaf criterion identifies sheaves of modules on this ringed site with the recorded levelwise-sheaf module presheaves. Rebundle the identical presheaves and maps in both directions; identity components give the inverse equivalence. Additivity and the required heterogeneous equalities are definitional.
